name: Kiai (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Karate, Power Attack, base attack bonus +4 or monk level 4.

Benefit(s): Once per round, while employing the karate style and making an unarmed attack, you may choose to let loose a shout, endowing your attack with additional force.

You deal +2 additional points of damage and +1 for every 4 BAB you possess. This bonus damage doubles if the attack was a Power Attack. This extra damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.
